statements.status_notes: webpack is a build-time tool; the runtime image only executes the Next.js standalone server bundle and never invokes webpack itself. The SSRF vulnerability requires running webpack's dev/build server, which the production image does not. The vulnerable code paths are not reachable through the entrypoint server.js.
